src_text: Notice: Council of Governors launches county development projects in Nandi County.
tgt_text: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Nandi.

src_text: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches the county integrated development plan in Vihiga County.
tgt_text: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Vihiga.
